notes: HUMAN-TRANSCRIBED (2105078). Phone-photo capture. 28 lines; 3 lines (11%) yielded nothing and are marked '[illegible]', the rest are readable with '[?]' spans. Nothing was guessed. ERA: this is a MODERN Bangladeshi deed -- the stamp reads গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকার (People's Republic of Bangladesh) at ৳২ / দুই টাকা, so it postdates 1971. dolil_20 by contrast is British-era (ONE RUPEE EIGHT ANNAS, date 15.1.19). The corpus therefore spans at least two states and roughly seventy years of registry practice, with different stamp formats, different endorsement languages and different survey vocabulary. deed_serial is EMPTY PENDING IDENTIFICATION: line 4 carries 'ণ/২ - ১৫০৮৫৪২' and '১৬৪৯', and line 27 carries '৪৬৮৪ নং' and '(৬)৫৮ নং'. ১৫০৮৫৪২ is recorded in extra_fields as stamp_paper_serial because it is 7 digits in the same position and format as dolil_13's stamp serial ৫০৯৩০৮৬, but which if any of these is the DEED serial is not established. land_amount is EMPTY PENDING A DECISION, and this page is the reason the field needs one: the deed conveys a share of MULTIPLE plots (দাগ), each with its own area -- ৩৪ ডিং, ১২ ডিং, ৬ ডিং, ৯ ১/২ ডি -- against a ১/৬ share, with '৮ ১/২' appearing twice as the portion actually moving ('তাহা হইতে মো: ৮ ১/২', 'মো:৩৬ ডিং এর ৮ ১/২'). A single scalar land_amount cannot represent this. The per-plot areas are recorded in extra_fields.area_by_dag so nothing is lost while the schema question is settled. deed_date is EMPTY BECAUSE ABSENT: no date was legible on the page. party_names lists the seven fully legible personal names. Their ROLES ARE NOT ESTABLISHED: unlike dolil_13 and dolil_20, this page carries no দাতা/গ্রহীতা labels in the legible text. Line 21 ('ওয়ারিশ সূত্রে খরিদ সূত্রে মালিক ও [?] দখলদার') indicates ownership by inheritance and purchase, so these are most likely co-heirs on one side, but that is not confirmed and the deed also references a ৩য় পক্ষ (third party). One further name is present but partly illegible ('[?] বেগম') and is excluded rather than guessed. This page IS ocr_f1 eligible (89% of lines carry recoverable text), unlike dolil_66.

notes: HUMAN-TRANSCRIBED (2105078). Phone-photo capture (EXIF orientation=6) but UNUSUALLY LEGIBLE: 29 lines, 0 fully illegible, only 2 '[?]' spans. This is a counterexample to the pattern in the other three pages -- capture method alone does not determine legibility; ink quality and handwriting matter as much. DEED TYPE: এত্তয়াজ হেবা নামা পত্র (heba-bil-ewaz, gift for consideration), not a সাফ কবলা sale like dolil_13/20. The corpus contains multiple instrument types. deed_serial '৯০০৩' IS AN INFERENCE ON THE LABEL, NOT ON THE READING: the digits were typed by the human transcriber, who read them twice (line 4 and line 11). What is inferred is that this repeated number is the DEED serial rather than something else -- it recurs in the registrar's endorsement block beside 'S. R. Joydebpur' and the registrar's own name, which is where a registration number belongs. This is the strongest deed_serial evidence in the held-out set so far; dolil_13, dolil_20, dolil_66 and dolil_348 yielded none. Reverse it by blanking this field if the reading is rejected.
